add_filter( 'the_content', 'custom_tutor_branded_pdf_links', 99 );

function custom_tutor_branded_pdf_links( $content ) {
	// Tutor renders frontend lesson content through admin-ajax.php.
	if ( is_feed() || ( is_admin() && ! wp_doing_ajax() ) ) {
		return $content;
	}

	if (
		! function_exists( 'tutor' ) ||
		! class_exists( 'DOMDocument' ) ||
		false === stripos( $content, '.pdf' )
	) {
		return $content;
	}

	global $post;

	if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post ) {
		return $content;
	}

	$tutor      = tutor();
	$post_types = array_filter(
		array(
			$tutor->course_post_type ?? 'courses',
			$tutor->lesson_post_type ?? 'lesson',
		)
	);

	if ( ! in_array( $post->post_type, $post_types, true ) ) {
		return $content;
	}

	$document = new DOMDocument( '1.0', 'UTF-8' );
	$root_id  = 'custom-tutor-pdf-content-' . wp_rand( 1000, 999999 );

	$previous_errors = libxml_use_internal_errors( true );
	$loaded          = $document->loadHTML(
		'<?xml encoding="utf-8" ?><div id="' . esc_attr( $root_id ) . '">' . $content . '</div>',
		LIBXML_HTML_NOIMPLIED | LIBXML_HTML_NODEFDTD
	);

	libxml_clear_errors();
	libxml_use_internal_errors( $previous_errors );

	if ( ! $loaded ) {
		return $content;
	}

	$root = $document->getElementById( $root_id );

	if ( ! $root ) {
		return $content;
	}

	$anchors = array();

	foreach ( $root->getElementsByTagName( 'a' ) as $anchor ) {
		$anchors[] = $anchor;
	}

	$site_host     = strtolower( (string) wp_parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_HOST ) );
	$site_port     = (string) wp_parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_PORT );
	$embedded_urls = array();

	foreach ( $anchors as $anchor ) {
		$href = trim( html_entity_decode( $anchor->getAttribute( 'href' ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );

		if ( '' === $href ) {
			continue;
		}

		$path = (string) wp_parse_url( $href, PHP_URL_PATH );

		if ( ! preg_match( '/\.pdf$/i', rawurldecode( $path ) ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$scheme = strtolower( (string) wp_parse_url( $href, PHP_URL_SCHEME ) );
		$host   = strtolower( (string) wp_parse_url( $href, PHP_URL_HOST ) );
		$port   = (string) wp_parse_url( $href, PHP_URL_PORT );

		if ( $scheme && ! in_array( $scheme, array( 'http', 'https' ), true ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		// Only embed PDFs hosted by this WordPress installation.
		if ( $host && ( $host !== $site_host || $port !== $site_port ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( ! $host ) {
			$href = home_url( '/' . ltrim( $href, '/' ) );
		}

		$pdf_url = esc_url_raw( $href, array( 'http', 'https' ) );

		if ( ! $pdf_url || isset( $embedded_urls[ $pdf_url ] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$embedded_urls[ $pdf_url ] = true;

		$viewer = $document->createElement( 'div' );
		$viewer->setAttribute( 'class', 'custom-tutor-pdf-viewer' );
		$viewer->setAttribute( 'data-pdf-url', $pdf_url );

		// This remains visible when JavaScript or the CDN is unavailable.
		$fallback = $document->createElement( 'p' );
		$fallback->setAttribute( 'class', 'custom-tutor-pdf-fallback' );

		$fallback_link = $document->createElement(
			'a',
			__( 'Open PDF in a new tab', 'astra' )
		);
		$fallback_link->setAttribute( 'href', $pdf_url );
		$fallback_link->setAttribute( 'target', '_blank' );
		$fallback_link->setAttribute( 'rel', 'noopener noreferrer' );

		$fallback->appendChild( $fallback_link );
		$viewer->appendChild( $fallback );

		$parent        = $anchor->parentNode;
		$is_standalone = false;

		if ( $parent instanceof DOMElement && 'p' === strtolower( $parent->tagName ) ) {
			$is_standalone = true;

			foreach ( $parent->childNodes as $child ) {
				if ( $child === $anchor ) {
					continue;
				}

				if ( XML_TEXT_NODE === $child->nodeType && '' === trim( $child->nodeValue ) ) {
					continue;
				}

				if (
					XML_ELEMENT_NODE === $child->nodeType &&
					'br' === strtolower( $child->nodeName )
				) {
					continue;
				}

				$is_standalone = false;
				break;
			}
		}

		if ( $is_standalone && $parent->parentNode ) {
			$parent->parentNode->replaceChild( $viewer, $parent );
		} elseif ( $parent && $parent->parentNode ) {
			// Preserve a link that is part of a larger sentence.
			if ( $parent->nextSibling ) {
				$parent->parentNode->insertBefore( $viewer, $parent->nextSibling );
			} else {
				$parent->parentNode->appendChild( $viewer );
			}
		}
	}

	$output = '';

	foreach ( $root->childNodes as $child ) {
		$output .= $document->saveHTML( $child );
	}

	return $output ?: $content;
}

/**
 * Print the branded viewer styles and PDF.js module once on Tutor content.
 */
add_action( 'wp_footer', 'custom_tutor_branded_pdf_assets', 99 );

function custom_tutor_branded_pdf_assets() {
	if ( is_admin() || ! function_exists( 'tutor' ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$tutor      = tutor();
	$post_types = array_filter(
		array(
			$tutor->course_post_type ?? 'courses',
			$tutor->lesson_post_type ?? 'lesson',
		)
	);

	if ( ! is_singular( $post_types ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$pdfjs_module = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@5.7.284/build/pdf.min.mjs';
	$pdfjs_worker = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@5.7.284/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs';
	?>
	<style id="custom-tutor-pdf-viewer-css">
		.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer {
			--ctpv-brand: #3e64de;
			--ctpv-brand-hover: #3154c7;
			--ctpv-surface: #eef1f6;
			--ctpv-border: #dfe3eb;
			width: 100%;
			margin: 24px 0;
			overflow: hidden;
			border: 1px solid var(--ctpv-border);
			border-radius: 10px;
			background: var(--ctpv-surface);
			box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(24, 34, 52, 0.08);
		}

		.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer * {
			box-sizing: border-box;
		}

		.ctpv-toolbar {
			display: flex;
			align-items: center;
			justify-content: center;
			gap: 6px;
			min-height: 54px;
			padding: 8px 12px;
			overflow-x: auto;
			color: #fff;
			background: var(--ctpv-brand);
			scrollbar-width: thin;
		}

		.ctpv-toolbar-group {
			display: inline-flex;
			align-items: center;
			flex: 0 0 auto;
			gap: 5px;
		}

		.ctpv-divider {
			width: 1px;
			height: 26px;
			flex: 0 0 auto;
			margin: 0 3px;
			background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
		}

		.ctpv-button {
			display: inline-flex;
			align-items: center;
			justify-content: center;
			min-width: 36px;
			height: 36px;
			margin: 0;
			padding: 7px 9px;
			border: 0;
			border-radius: 6px;
			outline: none;
			color: #fff;
			background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13);
			box-shadow: none;
			cursor: pointer;
			transition: background-color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
		}

		.ctpv-button:hover,
		.ctpv-button:focus-visible {
			color: #fff;
			background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
		}

		.ctpv-button:focus-visible {
			outline: 2px solid #fff;
			outline-offset: 1px;
		}

		.ctpv-button:disabled {
			opacity: 0.42;
			cursor: not-allowed;
		}

		.ctpv-button svg {
			width: 19px;
			height: 19px;
			fill: none;
			stroke: currentColor;
			stroke-width: 1.8;
			stroke-linecap: round;
			stroke-linejoin: round;
			pointer-events: none;
		}

		.ctpv-zoom-value {
			min-width: 64px;
			font-size: 13px;
			font-weight: 600;
			line-height: 1;
		}

		.ctpv-page-control {
			display: inline-flex;
			align-items: center;
			gap: 6px;
			height: 36px;
			padding: 0 9px;
			border-radius: 6px;
			background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
			font-size: 13px;
			font-weight: 600;
			white-space: nowrap;
		}

		.ctpv-page-input {
			width: 45px !important;
			height: 27px !important;
			min-height: 0 !important;
			margin: 0 !important;
			padding: 2px 5px !important;
			border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38) !important;
			border-radius: 4px !important;
			outline: none !important;
			color: #172033 !important;
			background: #fff !important;
			box-shadow: none !important;
			font-size: 13px !important;
			font-weight: 600 !important;
			line-height: 1 !important;
			text-align: center !important;
			-moz-appearance: textfield;
		}

		.ctpv-page-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button,
		.ctpv-page-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button {
			margin: 0;
			-webkit-appearance: none;
		}

		.ctpv-stage {
			position: relative;
			width: 100%;
			height: clamp(480px, 70vh, 800px);
			padding: 20px;
			overflow: auto;
			background: var(--ctpv-surface);
		}

		.ctpv-canvas {
			display: block;
			margin: 0 auto;
			background: #fff;
			box-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(24, 34, 52, 0.18);
		}

		.ctpv-status {
			position: absolute;
			inset: 0;
			z-index: 2;
			display: flex;
			align-items: center;
			justify-content: center;
			padding: 24px;
			color: #596579;
			background: var(--ctpv-surface);
			font-size: 14px;
			text-align: center;
		}

		.ctpv-status[hidden] {
			display: none;
		}

		.ctpv-spinner {
			width: 28px;
			height: 28px;
			margin-right: 10px;
			border: 3px solid #d7ddea;
			border-top-color: var(--ctpv-brand);
			border-radius: 50%;
			animation: ctpv-spin 0.75s linear infinite;
		}

		.ctpv-error {
			flex-direction: column;
			gap: 10px;
			color: #8a2633;
		}

		.ctpv-error a {
			color: var(--ctpv-brand);
			font-weight: 600;
		}

		.custom-tutor-pdf-fallback {
			margin: 0;
			padding: 16px;
			text-align: center;
		}

		.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer:fullscreen {
			display: flex;
			flex-direction: column;
			width: 100vw;
			height: 100vh;
			margin: 0;
			border: 0;
			border-radius: 0;
			background: var(--ctpv-surface);
		}

		.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer:fullscreen .ctpv-toolbar {
			flex: 0 0 auto;
		}

		.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer:fullscreen .ctpv-stage {
			flex: 1 1 auto;
			height: auto;
		}

		@keyframes ctpv-spin {
			to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
		}

		@media (max-width: 600px) {
			.ctpv-toolbar {
				justify-content: flex-start;
			}

			.ctpv-stage {
				height: 68vh;
				padding: 12px;
			}
		}

		@media print {
			.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer {
				display: none !important;
			}
		}
	</style>

	<script type="module" id="custom-tutor-pdf-viewer-js">
		const PDFJS_MODULE = <?php echo wp_json_encode( $pdfjs_module ); ?>;
		const PDFJS_WORKER = <?php echo wp_json_encode( $pdfjs_worker ); ?>;

		const pdfjsLib = await import(PDFJS_MODULE);
		pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = PDFJS_WORKER;

		const icon = (paths) =>
			`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${paths}</svg>`;

		const icons = {
			previous: icon('<path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/>'),
			next: icon('<path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/>'),
			minus: icon('<path d="M5 12h14"/>'),
			plus: icon('<path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>'),
			fullscreen: icon('<path d="M8 3H3v5M16 3h5v5M8 21H3v-5M16 21h5v-5"/>'),
			download: icon('<path d="M12 3v12m0 0 4-4m-4 4-4-4M5 21h14"/>'),
			print: icon('<path d="M7 9V3h10v6M7 17H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2M7 14h10v7H7z"/>')
		};

		const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

		function viewerTemplate() {
			return `
				<div class="ctpv-toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="PDF controls">
					<div class="ctpv-toolbar-group">
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button" data-action="previous" aria-label="Previous page" title="Previous page">${icons.previous}</button>
						<div class="ctpv-page-control">
							<input class="ctpv-page-input" data-role="page-input" type="number" min="1" value="1" aria-label="Current page">
							<span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
							<span data-role="page-total">—</span>
						</div>
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button" data-action="next" aria-label="Next page" title="Next page">${icons.next}</button>
					</div>

					<span class="ctpv-divider" aria-hidden="true"></span>

					<div class="ctpv-toolbar-group">
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button" data-action="zoom-out" aria-label="Zoom out" title="Zoom out">${icons.minus}</button>
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button ctpv-zoom-value" data-action="fit" aria-label="Fit page width" title="Fit page width">
							<span data-role="zoom-value">100%</span>
						</button>
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button" data-action="zoom-in" aria-label="Zoom in" title="Zoom in">${icons.plus}</button>
					</div>

					<span class="ctpv-divider" aria-hidden="true"></span>

					<div class="ctpv-toolbar-group">
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button" data-action="fullscreen" aria-label="Toggle fullscreen" title="Fullscreen">${icons.fullscreen}</button>
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button" data-action="download" aria-label="Download PDF" title="Download">${icons.download}</button>
						<button type="button" class="ctpv-button" data-action="print" aria-label="Print PDF" title="Print">${icons.print}</button>
					</div>
				</div>

				<div class="ctpv-stage">
					<canvas class="ctpv-canvas" aria-label="PDF page"></canvas>
					<div class="ctpv-status ctpv-loading" data-role="loading">
						<span class="ctpv-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
						<span>Loading PDF…</span>
					</div>
					<div class="ctpv-status ctpv-error" data-role="error" hidden>
						<strong>Unable to display this PDF.</strong>
						<a data-role="error-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open PDF in a new tab</a>
					</div>
				</div>
			`;
		}

		async function initializeViewer(viewer) {
			if (viewer.dataset.pdfViewerReady) {
				return;
			}

			viewer.dataset.pdfViewerReady = 'loading';

			const url = viewer.dataset.pdfUrl;

			if (!url) {
				return;
			}

			viewer.innerHTML = viewerTemplate();

			const stage = viewer.querySelector('.ctpv-stage');
			const canvas = viewer.querySelector('.ctpv-canvas');
			const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
			const loading = viewer.querySelector('[data-role="loading"]');
			const errorBox = viewer.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
			const errorLink = viewer.querySelector('[data-role="error-link"]');
			const pageInput = viewer.querySelector('[data-role="page-input"]');
			const pageTotal = viewer.querySelector('[data-role="page-total"]');
			const zoomValue = viewer.querySelector('[data-role="zoom-value"]');
			const previousButton = viewer.querySelector('[data-action="previous"]');
			const nextButton = viewer.querySelector('[data-action="next"]');

			errorLink.href = url;

			let pdf = null;
			let pageNumber = 1;
			let scale = 1;
			let fitToWidth = true;
			let rendering = false;
			let renderAgain = false;
			let resizeFrame = 0;

			const updateControls = () => {
				const pages = pdf ? pdf.numPages : 1;
				pageInput.value = String(pageNumber);
				pageInput.max = String(pages);
				pageTotal.textContent = pdf ? String(pages) : '—';
				zoomValue.textContent = `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
				previousButton.disabled = !pdf || pageNumber <= 1;
				nextButton.disabled = !pdf || pageNumber >= pages;
			};

			const calculateFitScale = (viewport) => {
				const horizontalPadding = window.innerWidth <= 600 ? 24 : 40;
				const availableWidth = Math.max(stage.clientWidth - horizontalPadding, 180);
				return clamp(availableWidth / viewport.width, 0.25, 2.5);
			};

			const renderPage = async () => {
				if (!pdf) {
					return;
				}

				if (rendering) {
					renderAgain = true;
					return;
				}

				rendering = true;
				loading.hidden = false;

				try {
					const page = await pdf.getPage(pageNumber);
					const baseViewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });

					if (fitToWidth) {
						scale = calculateFitScale(baseViewport);
					}

					const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });
					const outputScale = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

					canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * outputScale);
					canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * outputScale);
					canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
					canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;

					const transform = outputScale !== 1
						? [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0]
						: null;

					await page.render({
						canvasContext: context,
						transform,
						viewport
					}).promise;

					updateControls();
					stage.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
					viewer.dataset.pdfViewerReady = 'ready';
				} catch (error) {
					console.error('Tutor PDF viewer render error:', error);
					errorBox.hidden = false;
				} finally {
					loading.hidden = true;
					rendering = false;

					if (renderAgain) {
						renderAgain = false;
						renderPage();
					}
				}
			};

			const goToPage = (requestedPage) => {
				if (!pdf) {
					return;
				}

				const nextPage = clamp(Number.parseInt(requestedPage, 10) || 1, 1, pdf.numPages);

				if (nextPage !== pageNumber) {
					pageNumber = nextPage;
					renderPage();
				} else {
					updateControls();
				}
			};

			const zoomBy = (amount) => {
				fitToWidth = false;
				scale = clamp(Number((scale + amount).toFixed(2)), 0.25, 3);
				renderPage();
			};

			const downloadPdf = () => {
				const link = document.createElement('a');
				link.href = url;
				link.download = decodeURIComponent(url.split('/').pop().split('?')[0]) || 'document.pdf';
				link.rel = 'noopener';
				document.body.appendChild(link);
				link.click();
				link.remove();
			};

			const printPdf = () => {
				const printFrame = document.createElement('iframe');
				printFrame.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
				printFrame.style.position = 'fixed';
				printFrame.style.right = '0';
				printFrame.style.bottom = '0';
				printFrame.style.width = '1px';
				printFrame.style.height = '1px';
				printFrame.style.border = '0';
				printFrame.style.opacity = '0';
				printFrame.src = url;

				printFrame.addEventListener('load', () => {
					window.setTimeout(() => {
						try {
							printFrame.contentWindow.focus();
							printFrame.contentWindow.print();
						} catch (error) {
							window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener');
						}

						window.setTimeout(() => printFrame.remove(), 3000);
					}, 750);
				}, { once: true });

				document.body.appendChild(printFrame);
			};

			viewer.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
				const button = event.target.closest('[data-action]');

				if (!button || button.disabled) {
					return;
				}

				switch (button.dataset.action) {
					case 'previous':
						goToPage(pageNumber - 1);
						break;
					case 'next':
						goToPage(pageNumber + 1);
						break;
					case 'zoom-out':
						zoomBy(-0.15);
						break;
					case 'zoom-in':
						zoomBy(0.15);
						break;
					case 'fit':
						fitToWidth = true;
						renderPage();
						break;
					case 'fullscreen':
						if (document.fullscreenElement === viewer) {
							document.exitFullscreen();
						} else if (viewer.requestFullscreen) {
							viewer.requestFullscreen();
						}
						break;
					case 'download':
						downloadPdf();
						break;
					case 'print':
						printPdf();
						break;
				}
			});

			pageInput.addEventListener('change', () => goToPage(pageInput.value));
			pageInput.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
				if (event.key === 'Enter') {
					event.preventDefault();
					goToPage(pageInput.value);
					pageInput.blur();
				}
			});

			window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
				if (!fitToWidth || !pdf) {
					return;
				}

				window.cancelAnimationFrame(resizeFrame);
				resizeFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(renderPage);
			});

			document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
				if (fitToWidth && pdf && (document.fullscreenElement === viewer || !document.fullscreenElement)) {
					window.setTimeout(renderPage, 80);
				}
			});

			try {
				pdf = await pdfjsLib.getDocument({ url }).promise;
				pageTotal.textContent = String(pdf.numPages);
				updateControls();
				await renderPage();
			} catch (error) {
				console.error('Tutor PDF viewer load error:', error);
				loading.hidden = true;
				errorBox.hidden = false;
				viewer.dataset.pdfViewerReady = 'error';
			}
		}

		const initializeWithin = (root = document) => {
			if (root.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE && root !== document) {
				return;
			}

			if (root.matches && root.matches('.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer')) {
				initializeViewer(root);
			}

			if (root.querySelectorAll) {
				root.querySelectorAll('.custom-tutor-pdf-viewer').forEach(initializeViewer);
			}
		};

		initializeWithin(document);

		const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
			for (const mutation of mutations) {
				for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
					initializeWithin(node);
				}
			}
		});

		observer.observe(document.body, {
			childList: true,
			subtree: true
		});
	</script>
	<?php
}
